character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: jet-black hair in a precise side part, expressive dark eyes, with a stable distinctive face and adult proportions. They are a silent-film pianist accompanying the last screenings at a neighborhood cinema. Their signature costume is a black waistcoat over a white shirt, narrow tie, dark trousers, and polished shoes. Their defining personal object is a small ivory piano key kept in his vest pocket. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining object consistent across every scene.
consistency_rules: Maintain one fixed lead character for the full theme video.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Preserve the signature outfit design and the same personal item or tool in all scenes.
Do not change the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with silver white, charcoal, sepia, curtain red; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow dolly along the projector beam, wide shot of a theatre hall with a glowing screen, close-up of film reel sprockets; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
